annotations.title: Get saved scrape or run results

description: Fetch the rows of one of the user's saved scrapes or scheduled runs by id and show them as a table. Use list_my_saved_scrapes or list_my_runs first to find the id.

id.description: Id of a saved scrape (from list_my_saved_scrapes) or of a scheduled run (from list_my_runs).

kind.description: Whether `id` is a saved scrape or a scheduled run.

name: get_run_results
title: Get saved scrape or run results
